purpose: Implement and test, without endpoint access, the five upstream Causal-LoCoMo controls that can operate on the frozen inference-blind view.

selection_contract.cmi-no-memory: No memory or history is placed in the answer prompt.
selection_contract.cmi-full-history: All inference-visible past sessions are rendered chronologically; selected IDs retain the upstream all-memory accounting convention.
selection_contract.cmi-vector-memory: Embed the query once and every inference-visible memory separately with the frozen 1024-dimensional endpoint; cosine rank top 5, descending score then original memory order; any endpoint, shape, non-finite or zero-norm error is terminal with no deterministic fallback.
selection_contract.cmi-summary-memory: Join the first eight inference-visible memory contents in source order into one summary evidence item, while accounting all original memory IDs as selected to preserve upstream behavior.
selection_contract.cmi-graph-memory: Reproduce upstream concept-token and Jaccard scoring over content, omitting scope nodes because scope is evaluator-leaking in the released artifact; rank top 5, descending score then original memory order.

matched_calls.transport: Not implemented or authorized in this proposal; a later frozen lifecycle successor must inject loopback-only endpoints.

future_denominator.row_rule: Each requested eligible method/example/seed emits exactly one ACCEPTED or FAILED row. The two protocol-blocked methods require separate blocker receipts for all registered rows.

known_fidelity_boundaries: Graph scope nodes are removed because one released scope value encodes synthetic_adversarial and scope is excluded by the frozen inference firewall.
Vector retrieval fails closed instead of using upstream deterministic_embedding after any exception.
Stable source-order tie breaks are explicit because upstream tuple sorting has no safe equal-score MemoryCard ordering.
No method sees label, type, expected_effect, gold IDs, bad IDs, scoring criteria, expected answer, or evaluator metadata.
next_gate: Only after WMA release: bind the implementation hash, package a synthetic-only lifecycle conformance stage, create all 522 blocked-row receipts, and freeze fresh remote roots before any real call.
authorization: This proposal permits local mock tests only. It authorizes no server file creation, endpoint call, model service, dataset materialization, numerical execution, score reading, table admission, SOTA claim, or cleanup.
